skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with 2 combo hits, dealing 50% ATK DMG each.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes enemies in a cross-shaped area with 3 combo hits, dealing 40% ATK DMG each; the final hit drains 100% of the DMG dealt to heal herself.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes enemies in a cross-shaped area with 3 combo hits, dealing 40% ATK DMG each; the final hit drains 100% of the DMG dealt to heal herself, and the first and second hits each have a 100% chance to drain 100% of the DMG dealt to heal as well.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. After each action, heals the 1 ally with the lowest HP percentage, healing for 100% of Mosquito Girl's ATK.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. After each action, heals the 2 allies with the lowest HP percentage, healing for 100% of Mosquito Girl's ATK.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. After each action, heals the 2 allies with the lowest HP percentage, healing for 105% of Mosquito Girl's ATK.
